description.value: Master Rice Roll (腸粉大王) is a Chinese specialty restaurant in Richmond focused on cheung fun (rice rolls) and congee, offering more than 20 varieties of rice roll alone. Located in a retail unit on Number 3 Road, it also serves a range of snacks and drinks. Cyclists passing through Richmond's busy commercial corridor will find it a practical stop for a quick, filling Cantonese meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (mmrr.ca, last modified 2025-08-06) confirms the business is active and operating at 140-4200 No. 3 Rd, Richmond, matching the OSM address. The site explicitly promotes online delivery ordering ('訂餐外送 Order Delivery'), confirming takeout/delivery service. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: No phone number found in OSM tags or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed by a live website updated in August 2025, operating at the OSM-listed address in Richmond.
